text_content: Bag packed, lights off, and airport bound for the next 10 days! Hawaii here we come 🌺✈️
Sunset over Waikiki beach. Unplugged and peaceful.
Beautiful crisp 62F morning for a run around the neighborhood. Coffee time!
Tough afternoon at the medical center, but feeling grateful for my care team. Taking the evening to rest.
New ceramic collection design exploration. Slow steady progress.
Officially entering my 30s today! Born May 14, 1996 and loving the journey so far 🎉
Happy 3rd birthday to my favorite golden retriever, Barnaby! Best hiking partner ever 🐶
Great catching up with old classmates at the Oakfield Elementary 20-year alumni picnic! Can't believe it's been that long.
